title: 我们的时光相册
footer: 一段冒险，一段故事，一段友情o(*￣▽￣*)ブ
script: <script>window.addEventListener('load', function() { var cards = document.querySelectorAll('a'); cards.forEach(function(card) { if(card.href && (card.href.includes('gallery') || card.href.includes('.html'))) { card.style.transition = 'all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)'; card.style.borderRadius = '16px'; card.style.border = '3px solid transparent'; card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { this.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px) scale(1.02)'; this.style.boxShadow = '0 15px 40px rgba(251, 114, 153, 0.3)'; this.style.borderColor = '#FB7299'; var img = this.querySelector('img'); if(img) { img.style.transition = 'transform 0.6s ease'; img.style.transform = 'scale(1.08)'; } }); card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { this.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)'; this.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 20px rgba(251, 114, 153, 0.12)'; this.style.borderColor = 'transparent'; var img = this.querySelector('img'); if(img) { img.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; } }); } }); });</script>
